For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This stack is designed to be scalable, customizable, and easy to deploy, enabling creators to focus on building their businesses without worrying about infrastructure constraints.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Creators can save up to $921 per month by switching from Gumroad to NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure solution include the Sovereign Starter Stack, the Edge Commerce Stack, and the Complete Builder Kit. The Sovereign Starter Stack is a basic deployment package that includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while the Edge Commerce Stack adds Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for more advanced features. The Complete Builder Kit is a comprehensive package that includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant download access to all the necessary tools and resources.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by purchasing the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Complete Builder Kit from the COREMERCH shop. They can then follow the provided documentation and deployment guides to set up their infrastructure, load their products, and configure payment processing. With the right tools and knowledge, creators can have a fully operational online store up and running in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
By owning their infrastructure, creators can avoid platform fees and maintain control over their data.

For digital creators looking to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software online without relying on conventional payment gateways, the COREMERCH infrastructure solution is a game-changer. With the Complete Builder Kit, creators can get everything they need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including the Sovereign Starter Stack, the Edge Commerce Stack, and all the necessary tools and resources. Visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more and start building your own sovereign digital commerce stack today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Complete Builder Kit from the COREMERCH shop. Set up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting environment. Configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic. Integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Configure NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Load your products and configure payment processing. Test and deploy your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my existing e-commerce platform?

NOWPayments provides a simple API for integrating with existing e-commerce platforms. Simply follow the provided documentation and API guidelines to set up NOWPayments and configure payment processing for your platform.
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack is a basic deployment package that includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while the Edge Commerce Stack adds Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for more advanced features.
Can I use this infrastructure solution to sell physical products?
While this infrastructure solution is designed for digital products, it can be adapted for physical products with some modification. However, this may require additional configuration and setup.
How do I scale my infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales?
To scale your infrastructure, simply upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for more advanced features and better performance.
Can I use this infrastructure solution with other payment gateways?
NOWPayments is the recommended payment gateway for this infrastructure solution, but it can be integrated with other payment gateways with some modification and additional setup.
